verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK, so CPU-architecture coverage is a fair axis. The evidence only covers phones, Snapdragon Hexagon NPUs and Apple M3+ Metal GPUs, plus generic claims like "whatever silicon the device has". Nothing documents support for PowerPC or any CPU architecture beyond x86 and ARM.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
